# Wise Leaders Academy

> Licensed home daycare in West Adams and Mid-City, Los Angeles, serving children ages 1–6. State License #197495535. Programs emphasize safety, low teacher ratios, and play-based learning.

Wise Leaders Academy helps families find nurturing, education-focused childcare in Los Angeles. Use the links below for enrollment, tours, tuition information, and parent resources.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://www.wiseleadersacademy.com/): Programs, curriculum highlights, parent testimonials, and tuition guide request
- [About](https://www.wiseleadersacademy.com/about/): Mission, philosophy, curriculum pillars, and teacher ratios
- [Gallery](https://www.wiseleadersacademy.com/gallery/): Photos of daily life and learning environments
- [Contact](https://www.wiseleadersacademy.com/contact/): Schedule a tour, ask about enrollment, or send a message
